from.question: The conflation I think will bite you hardest. You hold NVDA equity; suppose you also hold NVDA converts and are short NVDA calls. That is three Instruments, one Issuer, and exactly ONE earnings event. If earnings hangs off the ticker you get three earnings blocks on the same morning; if it hangs off the Issuer you get one, with three position lines under it. Is Issuer a real object for you, or does your book only ever hold one instrument per company - in which case I should collapse these two and stop being clever?
